The life of your pet cat with kidney problems costs between 4,000 and 6,000 reais. That's the price of its life. If you don't have that money, your cat will be hospitalized for 2 days, you'll spend 2,000 reais, and in the end, your feline will return home sick, just as it arrived. You'll be throwing 2,000 reais down the drain. If you are wealthy and have the money, your beloved feline will survive. If you don't have the money, they will ask you to remove your cat. In that case, you will have to watch your cat slowly die at home. Love and respect for animal life? Forget it. Love is for money.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency room today for the second time in a week for the same problem, kidney failure. She had a seizure and we returned again. Last Friday, the on-call doctor, Dr. Maria Vitória, informed us that she would be entitled to a follow-up appointment within 30 days for the same problem, meaning they wouldn't charge for the consultation. This was not done by the on-call doctor, Fernanda Fernandes, who said that the follow-up appointment would only be during daytime hours, which is absurd, because how are we supposed to know when the seizure will happen? And coincidentally, it happened at 4:30 in the morning. In other words, we paid R$390.00 last Friday and another R$300.00 today. She only administered diazepam rectally and subcutaneous rigid saline solution and said that this is the procedure to stop the seizure, or we should have her admitted there. Last week the vet performed another procedure, administering ondansetron, scopolamine, B vitamins, and glucose intravenously, and my dog ​​recovered much better. This time, however, she is lethargic, prostrate, moaning, and having spasms. She didn't even provide documentation (perhaps to avoid incriminating herself if something happens at home) detailing what she administered. In other words, they only care about the money; they have no empathy for the pain of the owner or the animal. What she did, I was already doing at home – administering the IV fluids, and we even informed them that she received them around 11 PM. So, I paid R$300.00 for her to do what I was already doing without the diazepam. And my dog ​​is not doing well. It's very sad how they treat people. They are cold. I called at 6:50 AM to speak with the vet. Fernanda explained the procedure she performed, which wasn't intravenous, even though it should have been an emergency. I told her my dog's heart was racing, she was whimpering, and having spasms, and she didn't even explain, simply hanging up on me twice. She kept calling me "my dear," and when I told her not to call me that, she hung up again. Totally unethical and unprofessional. And when I told her to administer glucose and B-complex vitamins, she sarcastically asked if that would save my dog. She even said she would talk to the clinic owner about the reimbursement issue. In other words, they only care about the money all the time. R$150.00 for a consultation isn't cheap; if we went back, it's because we believed the first doctor's word.

Earlier this year, I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet at the last minute, and the woman who claimed to be a veterinarian put my dog ​​on an IV drip and gave me a quote for one night's stay, which would be around 900 reais. I explained that I couldn't afford that at the moment, so she turned off the IV and administered an extremely strong human medication (100 mg of Gadernal and 40 mg of furosemide) even though my dog ​​was weak and lethargic! Furthermore, she said my dog ​​didn't have much time left and might soon have to be euthanized, telling me to take her home and give her the medication. My dog ​​stopped eating, became weaker, and just slept all the time. After 3 days, I took her to another veterinarian who treated me very well and told me that the medications this woman had prescribed could kill my dog ​​if I continued for another 2 days. In the end, my dog ​​had a kind of canine labyrinthitis and old dog syndrome. I am very sad to see this lack of humanity and compassion in certain human beings who clearly do things not out of love, but for money!! Thank God and this doctor who was sent by angels that my dog ​​is well, healthy and ALIVE, because if it were up to that woman, she wouldn't be here anymore!!
